name: Pachuca

queries.query: Pachuca Hidalgo official cadastral parcel map GIS catastro predial service WFS
queries.result: Found the official Instituto Catastral del Estado de Hidalgo, the municipal Pachuca predial/cadastre portal, the SITEP territorial viewer, and the state geoportal. The sources establish cadastral custodians and public map portals, but no anonymous parcel feature endpoint returning a safe native ID and polygon was verified.

queries.query: Pachuca Hidalgo catastro mapa predial oficial SIG parcelas predios servicio público
queries.result: Se confirmó al Instituto Catastral del Estado de Hidalgo como custodio estatal y al Ayuntamiento de Pachuca/IMIP como custodio y proveedor municipal de planos y SITEP. La consulta de predial requiere cuenta predial; el sistema de gestión catastral requiere usuario y contraseña; no se verificó una respuesta anónima de identificador nativo seguro más geometría parcelaria.

source.provider: Instituto Catastral del Estado de Hidalgo and Ayuntamiento de Pachuca de Soto / Instituto Municipal de Investigación y Planeación
source.serviceType: Official state cadastral authority and municipal territorial/cadastral map portals; no public anonymous parcel feature service confirmed
safeFieldsRequested: stable native parcel ID if publicly exposed
source.scopeNote: Local/state custodians are evidenced. The municipal RUTS entry describes a paid/requested base plan containing boundaries, roads, neighborhoods and geographic elements, not parcel polygons. The state management system is login-gated and the public geoportal did not expose a parcel schema in the accessible response. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.

verifiedSample.result: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained; no GeoJSON sample retained. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Hidalgo state cadastral infrastructure and Pachuca municipal territorial/cadastral mapping services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Custodian identity and public portal existence verified; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity and citywide polygon access unverified.
